description: The 'dss_plugins_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about various live plugins available in the Dataiku platform. Each entry in the dataset represents a plugin, detailing its unique identifier, label, version, author, and a description of its functionality. The dataset also includes metadata such as tags for categorization, a boolean indicating if the plugin is in development, and a URL for more information. This dataset is particularly useful for developers and data scientists who are looking to integrate or utilize these plugins within their Dataiku projects. It allows users to quickly identify plugins by their capabilities and authorship, and to access further documentation through provided URLs. The inclusion of tags helps in filtering and searching for plugins based on specific needs or categories, such as 'NLP' or 'Geospatial'. Overall, this dataset serves as a valuable resource for managing and exploring the ecosystem of plugins in Dataiku, facilitating better project planning and execution.
shortDesc: Dataset of live Dataiku plugins with details and metadata.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each plugin, essential for reference.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Human-readable name of the plugin, useful for identification.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Version number of the plugin, indicating updates and changes.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Creator or contributors of the plugin, providing authorship details.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Keywords categorizing the plugin, aiding in search and filtering.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed explanation of the plugin's functionality and use cases.

columns.name: isDev
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is in development, useful for status tracking.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: Web link to the plugin's summary page, for more information.
